A.name: Chrome extension: toolbar popup
A.blurb: The popup opened from the toolbar icon. Controls the current page and shows the link to the desktop app.

B.name: Chrome extension: on-page reading
B.blurb: Selection bubble, paragraph play gutter, floating dock, read-along highlight, context menu and errors, drawn on a real article page.

C.name: Chrome extension: options and side panel
C.blurb: Extension settings page (connection, voice, highlight look, shortcuts, site rules) and the queue side panel.

D.name: Desktop app: first-run setup
D.blurb: Welcome, engine choice with hardware check, model download, extension pairing, test voice.

E.name: Desktop app: library
E.blurb: Home with saved readings, adding content (paste, URL, file, drag and drop), search.

F.name: Desktop app: reader
F.blurb: Text and PDF reading with read-along highlight, player bar, outline, display settings, sleep timer and finish states.

G.name: Voices and engines
G.blurb: Kokoro voice library, Chatterbox voice cloning, engine manager, hardware warnings.

H.name: Desktop app: settings
H.blurb: General, playback, pronunciation, browser integration, shortcuts, storage, appearance, about and updates.

I.name: Tray, mini player and global shortcuts
I.blurb: Always-available surfaces outside the main window.

J.name: Export audio
J.blurb: Save a reading as MP3 or WAV.

K.name: System states and errors
K.blurb: Crashes, resource problems, permission and update dialogs.

screens.title: Popup · idle on an article
screens.note: Nothing playing yet. One big action, selection (disabled until text is selected) and reader view.

screens.title: Popup · selection ready
screens.note: Text is selected on the page; the popup offers to read only that, with a real time estimate.

screens.title: Popup · preparing audio
screens.note: First sentence is being synthesized. Indeterminate bar, skip buttons disabled, Cancel available.

screens.title: Popup · playing
screens.note: Scrubber with time left, 10 s skips, previous/next paragraph.

screens.title: Popup · paused
screens.note: Same layout, play button instead of pause.

screens.title: Popup · voice picker
screens.note: Searchable voice list with language and accent filters; every row has a preview button.

screens.title: Popup · speed picker
screens.note: Slider with live value plus presets across the 0.5x to 3x range.

screens.title: Popup · finished
screens.note: End of page; main button becomes replay and the next queued item is offered.

screens.title: Popup · app not running
screens.note: The desktop app is closed. Launch it, or download it.

screens.title: Popup · model loading
screens.note: App is up but the voice engine is still starting. Skips disabled, Cancel available.

screens.title: Popup · page not readable
screens.note: Chrome internal pages and the Web Store block extensions.

screens.title: Popup · playing (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme follows the browser.

screens.title: Popup · app not installed
screens.note: First run: the app is not on this computer yet, so Download is the primary action.

screens.title: Popup · pairing token rejected
screens.note: App and browser no longer share a token; paste a new one in the extension options.

screens.title: Popup · local file needs permission
screens.note: file:// pages need “Allow access to file URLs” in the extension settings.

screens.title: Page · selection bubble
screens.note: Selecting text pops a bubble 8 px above the selection: Listen (with its shortcut on hover), voice and speed, copy.

screens.title: Page · paragraph play gutter
screens.note: Hovering a paragraph tints it and shows a play button in the margin: read from here.

screens.title: Page · context menu
screens.note: Native Chrome menu: SpeakKit submenu with read selection, read from here and add to queue.

screens.title: Page · dock idle
screens.note: Floating dock appears at the bottom after the first use (can be hidden per site).

screens.title: Page · dock preparing
screens.note: Spinner while the first chunk is synthesized.

screens.title: Page · reading with highlight
screens.note: Sentence background plus a stronger current-word marker; auto-scroll follows.

screens.title: Page · paused
screens.note: Highlight stays on the last spoken sentence; dock shows elapsed and total time.

screens.title: Page · finished
screens.note: Dock confirms the end and offers replay.

screens.title: Page · app offline error
screens.note: One surface only: the dock explains the problem and offers Open app and Retry; technical detail sits behind Details.

screens.title: Page · reader view reading
screens.note: Distraction-free reader overlay with larger type and the same highlight. Close keeps playback running in the dock.

screens.title: Page · reading (dark)
screens.note: Dark page and dark highlight palette.

screens.title: Page · reader view (dark)
screens.note: Reader view in dark mode.

screens.title: Page · added to queue
screens.note: Confirmation toast after Add to queue, with a link to the side panel.

screens.title: Page · back to current
screens.note: The reader scrolled away from the spoken sentence; a pill jumps back to it.

screens.title: Page · dock speed popover
screens.note: Speed popover opened from the dock pill; right edges aligned, slider shows the live value.

screens.title: Page · dock voice popover
screens.note: Voice popover opened from the dock voice chip, with search and a preview button on every row.

screens.title: Page · edge launcher, hidden
screens.note: Resting state: only a 14 px tab is visible at the right edge of the page, so it never covers content. Position is draggable up and down.

screens.title: Page · edge launcher, hover
screens.note: Hovering the tab opens a vertical pill, like Speechify: logo, a big play button (tooltip shows the length), reader view, speed, voice, more.

screens.title: Page · edge launcher, reading
screens.note: While reading, the tab stays peeking out wider with a pause button and a thin progress line. Click to pause or resume without opening it.

screens.title: Page · edge launcher, reading expanded
screens.note: Hover while reading: the pill stacks pause, a vertical progress rail with time left, 10 s skips, speed, voice and stop. Moving away hides it after 1.5 s.

screens.title: Page · edge launcher (dark)
screens.note: Same vertical pill on a dark page.

screens.title: Options · General (connected)
screens.note: Connection status with response time, port, pairing token and where the extension shows UI.

screens.title: Options · General (app not running)
screens.note: Same layout as connected; only the status card changes. Primary action launches the app, the error code sits behind Details.

screens.title: Options · General (token rejected)
screens.note: Pairing token mismatch: paste a new token into the focused field, with Re-pair as the fallback.

screens.title: Options · Voice and speed
screens.note: Engine cards with radio and install action, default voice, speed slider with live value, paragraph pause, preview.

screens.title: Options · Highlighting
screens.note: Preview with light/dark switch and contrast readout, named color swatches with a custom option.

screens.title: Options · Shortcuts
screens.note: Browser-wide Chrome shortcuts (edited in Chrome) and in-page keys, with Not set and conflict states.

screens.title: Options · Sites and filters
screens.note: Skip rules and per-site rules; each rule is a dropdown (Always show dock, Hide controls, Never read).

screens.title: Options · Highlighting (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Side panel · queue and outline
screens.note: Chrome side panel: now playing with transport, paragraph outline, up-next queue with Play now, Remove and Clear all.

screens.title: Side panel · empty queue
screens.note: Empty state explains how to add pages; the page reflows beside the panel.

screens.title: Side panel · queue (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Options · Edge launcher
screens.note: Turn the edge launcher on or off, choose its side, how it hides, when it opens and how long it stays open.

screens.title: Welcome
screens.note: First launch. One promise: local, private, fast.

screens.title: Choose engine (GPU found)
screens.note: Hardware verdict line; selectable engine cards, the button follows the selection.

screens.title: Choose engine (no GPU)
screens.note: Chatterbox is locked with the reason and a link instead of failing later.

screens.title: Downloading models
screens.note: Per-file progress, speed and ETA, the next step dimmed, can continue in the background.

screens.title: Download paused
screens.note: Resumable. Retry, choose a file you downloaded yourself, auto-retry and proxy options.

screens.title: Connect your browser
screens.note: Install, pin, then paste the pairing token. Continue stays disabled until the extension pairs.

screens.title: Ready: hear a sample
screens.note: Pairing confirmed. Press play to hear the voice; tips for the shortcut, tray and startup.

screens.title: Welcome (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Ready: extension skipped
screens.note: Setup finished without pairing; the extension can be connected later in Settings > Browser integration.

screens.title: Library · empty
screens.note: First run with no content: one primary action (Choose file), quieter ways to paste or use a web address.

screens.title: Library · with readings
screens.note: Continue-listening hero (not repeated in the list), filters, sort, rows with progress and time left.

screens.title: Add · paste text
screens.note: Dialog with optional title, live word count, estimated time, voice; Add or Add and play.

screens.title: Add · web address fetching
screens.note: Field is read-only while fetching; the found title confirms what will be added.

screens.title: Add · web address failed
screens.note: Reason in plain words, details behind a line; Paste text instead is the way forward.

screens.title: Library · dragging a file
screens.note: The whole content area becomes the drop target.

screens.title: Library · search results
screens.note: Matches highlighted in title, source or text, result count and a clear button.

screens.title: Library · no search results
screens.note: Clear search is the primary action; Add text is secondary.

screens.title: Library · row menu
screens.note: Anchored to the row's trigger: play, rename, export, pin, voice, finished, folder, delete.

screens.title: Library · delete confirmation
screens.note: Imported file: the original is untouched. Cancel has default focus.

screens.title: Library · with readings (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Library · deleted toast
screens.note: After deleting, a toast offers Undo.

screens.title: Library · added toast
screens.note: Success toast after adding; the new reading is at the top.

screens.title: Library · dragging several files
screens.note: Drop target lists each accepted file.

screens.title: Library · unsupported file
screens.note: Red drop target names the file type and lists the supported ones.

screens.title: Library · delete pasted text
screens.note: Pasted text has no original, so the copy says it is the only copy.

screens.title: Reader · playing
screens.note: Article with sentence and word highlight; the player bar shows 2:27 of 6:48 at 1.2x.

screens.title: Reader · paused
screens.note: Same screen paused.

screens.title: Reader · preparing next paragraph
screens.note: Short toast when synthesis falls behind; Pause stays available.

screens.title: Reader · finished
screens.note: Completion card over a scrim: marks the reading finished, plays the next item or replays.

screens.title: Reader · read from here
screens.note: Click a word: a chip above it offers Read from here and Copy.

screens.title: Reader · outline and bookmarks
screens.note: Right panel with headings and saved bookmarks.

screens.title: Reader · display settings
screens.note: Anchored to the Aa button: theme, text size and line spacing with values, font, toggles.

screens.title: Reader · sleep timer
screens.note: Anchored to the timer in the player bar; shows the 29:12 countdown.

screens.title: Reader · speed and voice
screens.note: Popover from the speed pill: slider with value, presets, voice and engine.

screens.title: PDF reader · playing
screens.note: Player bar shows the PDF's own title, page and duration.

screens.title: PDF reader · scanned page
screens.note: Page 9 has no text layer: offer local OCR; the player is disabled until it finishes.

screens.title: Reader · playing (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: PDF reader · recognizing text
screens.note: Local OCR progress: page 4 of 15, time left, cancel.

screens.title: Reader · voice panel
screens.note: Docked right panel: current voice, recent voices, speed slider, advanced.

screens.title: Reader · back to current
screens.note: After scrolling away from the spoken sentence, a pill jumps back.

screens.title: Reader · search in text
screens.note: Find bar with result count and previous/next; matches highlighted.

screens.title: Voices · library
screens.note: After Chatterbox is installed: Your voices on top, Kokoro voices as cards with accent, grade and preview (playing state shown), grade legend open.

screens.title: Voices · detail drawer
screens.note: Scrim under the drawer, previous/next voice, editable try-it sentence. Heart is already the default, so the button is disabled.

screens.title: Clone · choose reference
screens.note: Upload or record. Continue stays disabled until a clip is added and the consent box is ticked.

screens.title: Clone · recording
screens.note: Stop button, 0:08 / 0:30 timer with the 0:10 minimum tick, live input meter. Continue is disabled while recording.

screens.title: Clone · analyzing
screens.note: Three visible steps including GPU warm-up, with percentage and time left.

screens.title: Clone · name and test
screens.note: Name the voice, hear a test sentence, tune exaggeration (0.50 neutral).

screens.title: Clone · bad reference
screens.note: Per-criterion clip check: length and noise fail, single speaker passes. Next actions are choose another file or record.

screens.title: Engines · overview
screens.note: Before install: Kokoro ready, Chatterbox with GPU and disk fit checks and a 2.4 GB download.

screens.title: Engines · Chatterbox warming up
screens.note: GPU load progress after install, inside the card padding, with percentage.

screens.title: Engines · out of GPU memory
screens.note: Live GPU chip, top VRAM users, three ways forward. Raw CUDA text stays behind Details.

screens.title: Chatterbox · voice style
screens.note: Opened from Style on a cloned voice card. Sliders show values; scope is Maya (you).

screens.title: Voices · library (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Voices · list view
screens.note: Dense rows: play, name, accent, gender, grade, style, favorite. Scales to all 28 voices.

screens.title: Voices · cloning unavailable
screens.note: Chatterbox not installed: Clone is disabled with the reason, a requirements check and a link to Engines. Cloned voices are dimmed.

screens.title: Clone · review take
screens.note: After stopping: play back, re-record or use the take. All three clip checks pass.

screens.title: Engines · Chatterbox ready
screens.note: Installed card with the overflow menu: Test, Reveal in folder, Voice style, Uninstall.

screens.title: Settings · General
screens.note: Startup, tray, language, privacy and the clipboard prompt switch.

screens.title: Settings · Playback
screens.note: Speed slider with value (0.5× to 3×), pauses and text clean-up rules.

screens.title: Settings · Pronunciation
screens.note: Custom dictionary with respelling help, per-entry preview and delete with Undo.

screens.title: Settings · Browser integration
screens.note: Server status, port with Apply and re-pair, token, destructive actions with confirm text.

screens.title: Settings · Shortcuts
screens.note: Global Ctrl+Alt shortcuts, inline conflict on one row, in-app keys, Reset all.

screens.title: Settings · Storage and models
screens.note: Usage adds up to 1.6 GB, segmented bar with legend, Clear asks first.

screens.title: Settings · Appearance
screens.note: Theme, named highlight colors with a live preview.

screens.title: Settings · About
screens.note: Version, update result, links and one row per open-source library.

screens.title: Settings · Update available
screens.note: Update card with restart warning and Remind me later; dot on the About item.

screens.title: Settings · Browser integration (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Settings · Shortcuts (recording a key)
screens.note: Capture state: Press new keys, Esc to cancel.

screens.title: Tray menu · playing
screens.note: Windows 11 tray flyout, 12 px above the taskbar and aligned to the right edge: mini controls, Ctrl+Alt shortcuts, voice submenu, engine status.

screens.title: Tray menu · idle
screens.note: Same flyout when nothing is playing.

screens.title: Mini player · always on top
screens.note: Draggable header, time left, pin state with tooltip, previous/next and −10 / +10, overflow menu for the sleep timer. The document text stays visible.

screens.title: Global shortcut toast
screens.note: Ctrl+Alt+S reads the selected text in any app. The toast offers pause and Stop; Esc is not captured.

screens.title: Clipboard prompt
screens.note: Optional prompt after copying long text. Skips password-manager copies. Turn off lives in the … menu, with an 8 s countdown.

screens.title: Tray menu · playing (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Tray menu · engine loading
screens.note: Read actions are disabled while Kokoro loads; status shows the wait.

screens.title: Tray menu · engine error
screens.note: Engine stopped: red status, Restart engine, read actions disabled.

screens.title: Mini player · states
screens.note: Paused, preparing the voice, and finished (replay).

screens.title: Export · options
screens.note: Format, MP3 quality, voice and speed, file name, folder with Browse, size estimate.

screens.title: Export · rendering
screens.note: Progress per sentence. Run in background is primary; Cancel export is destructive. No header X.

screens.title: Export · done
screens.note: Full-width preview with time, path with Copy, Open file and Show in folder.

screens.title: Export · options (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Export · file exists
screens.note: Replace, Keep both, or Choose another name.

screens.title: Export · in background
screens.note: Sidebar progress pill and the library row show the running export.

screens.title: Export · complete toast
screens.note: Non-blocking toast with Show in folder.

screens.title: Error · engine crashed
screens.note: Over the reader with the player visible. Sidebar shows Restarting…; Details holds the exit code.

screens.title: Error · port in use
screens.note: Over Settings > Browser integration. Sidebar shows Extension link blocked; port number lives in Details.

screens.title: Error · low disk space
screens.note: Over Engines at the Chatterbox download card, with a hard-drive icon.

screens.title: Error · model checksum failed
screens.note: Over the library. Repair is the primary action; checksum sits behind Details; Open Engines because Chatterbox isn't installed.

screens.title: Notice · extension out of date
screens.note: Non-blocking banner under the title bar; no dialog.

screens.title: Permission · microphone blocked
screens.note: Over the clone screen after Record now. Upload a file is the alternative.

screens.title: Notice · already running
screens.note: No dialog: the existing window is restored and a toast says why.

screens.title: Notice · offline
screens.note: Status chip in the header plus a toast; nothing blocks the app.

screens.title: Error · engine crashed (dark)
screens.note: Dark theme variant.

screens.title: Error · repairing model
screens.note: Repair progress with size and time left; can run in the background.
